associationActivities.pending: Awaiting moderation. This content has not been published yet.
associationActivities.removed: This content was removed by moderation.

group.title: The association’s private group
group.lead: Joining the association and entering its group are separate choices. Discussions remain restricted to authorized group members.
group.notCreated: The association has not created its group yet.
group.created: The group is ready. No association member was added automatically.
group.closed: This group is closed. New discussions and memberships are stopped.
group.eligibility: To enter this group, your association membership must be accepted and your account must be allowed to publish.
group.leaveDescription: You will lose access to group discussions. This does not end your association membership.
group.closeDescription: Reading and new discussions will close for everyone. Data is retained. This closure is final in this flow.
group.bodyHint: Text for this group only, up to 2,000 characters. Do not share private contact details.
group.saved: Your text was saved. Its moderation status appears in the group.
group.removeDescription: This post will no longer be accessible in the group. Your membership is unchanged.

event.lead: The association organizes; each member chooses to register. Event registration is separate from association and group membership.
event.editorLead: The event is published in the association’s name, with the chosen audience and moderation. Nobody is registered automatically.
event.locationHint: Use a shared venue or meeting room. Do not publish a private address or personal contact details.
event.scheduleHint: Times use the chosen time zone. Once a participation exists, cancel and create another event to change dates or the time zone.
event.registrationCloseHint: Enter both fields in the event time zone, no later than its start. Leave both blank to close at the start. A past date immediately closes registration and promotions from the waiting list.
event.registrationReopenHint: To reopen registration, choose a future deadline or clear both fields. The waiting list is kept; withdrawals remain possible.
event.registrationClosureRule: After closing, no new requests or places are assigned from the waiting list. You can still withdraw your registration or request.
event.registrationClosed: Registration and places assigned from the waiting list are closed.
event.audienceHint: This choice stays within DIASPORALE. It does not publish on ANTSIA.
event.capacityHint: Leave blank for unlimited places, or enter a whole number from 1 to {{max}}.
event.capacityChangeHint: Increasing capacity or removing the limit allows people on the waiting list to be confirmed automatically, in order. Reducing capacity never removes a confirmed place.
event.saved: The event was saved. Its moderation status remains visible to the team.
event.placeRequestConsent: By requesting a place, you agree to join the waiting list if the event is full, then receive an available place automatically in waiting-list order. You can withdraw your request at any time.
event.waitlisted: Your request is on the waiting list.
event.waitlistPosition: Your request is waiting at position {{position}}.
event.reminderChoice: Choose a personal reminder in my notification bell 24 hours before the event
event.reminderHint: This is an optional, personal choice. On the waiting list, the reminder waits for your place to be confirmed. It does not guarantee a notification on your device.
event.reminderDemo: In demonstration mode, your choice is saved in this browser. No reminder is sent automatically.
event.reminderWaiting: Your reminder choice is waiting for your place to be confirmed.
event.reminderRecorded: Reminder added to your notification bell.
event.reminderExpired: The reminder time has passed. No new reminder is planned.
event.reminderTooLate: It is too late to enable a reminder 24 hours before this event.
event.cancelDescription: The event will be marked as cancelled. New registrations will close; accessible information will remain available to prevent unnecessary travel.

errors.association_group_access_required: Your current status does not allow access to this association group.
errors.association_group_exists: This association already has its group.
errors.association_event_invalid: Check the title, dates and time zone. The end must follow the start and the event cannot last longer than 14 days.
errors.association_event_version_changed: This event changed. Close the form and read its current version.
errors.association_event_cancelled: This event is cancelled; new registrations are closed.
errors.association_event_schedule_locked: A participation already exists. Cancel and create another event to change dates or the time zone.
errors.association_event_access_required: This event is not accessible with your current status.
errors.association_event_capacity_invalid: Enter a whole number of places from 1 to 10,000, or leave the field blank for no limit.
errors.association_event_capacity_below_confirm: Capacity cannot be lower than the number of places already confirmed.
errors.association_event_deadline_invalid: Enter a valid closing date and time in the event time zone, no later than its start, or leave both fields blank.
errors.association_event_registration_closed: Registration is closed; new requests and places assigned from the waiting list are stopped.
errors.association_event_reminder_too_late: It is too late to enable the reminder 24 hours before this event.
